links.outcome: Specificity of ADRD detection model on external pilot data versus benchmark test set
links.effect: Benchmark specificity 83.3% (78.0-88.7) vs pilot 52.5% (39.3-65.7); sensitivity similar (69.4% vs 70.0%).
links.quote: On pilot data, this model yields a mean sensitivity of 70.0% (58.0-82.0) and specificity of 52.5% (39.3-65.7).

unlisted_practices: Risk stratification of speech-model outputs for actionable triage
Explainable linguistic feature importance analysis for cognitive impairment screening

screen.reason: The study develops and tests ML models on speech features for cognitive impairment screening (using DementiaBank benchmark and retrospective pilot data) and explores risk stratification thresholds, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
